groups.lede: The basics, all in the first few missions.
The break-in kit. Most of it comes from the fences and the Heders.
The two you buy. Story robberies hand you a mask when you need one.

items.name: Binoculars
items.does: Look a long way off: scout a place before you go in, spot enemies and identify animals at a distance.
items.use: Pick them from the item wheel and aim.

items.name: Flashlight
items.does: Light for dark interiors and night-time. A torch attachment on a gun from Ammu-Nation does the same job with your weapon out.
items.use: Pick it from the item wheel.

items.name: Duffel Bag
items.does: Holds what you steal: drugs, jewelry and marked bills go in it when you pick them up.
items.use: Comes out on its own when you grab stolen goods.

items.name: Metal Detector
items.does: Finds treasure on the sea floor: Kenton's wrecks and the underwater discoveries.
items.use: Take it from a boat before you dive.

items.name: Slim Jim
items.does: Opens a locked car door without smashing the window, so stealing a parked car doesn't draw attention.
items.use: Used on its own when you try a locked car.

items.name: Pry Bar
items.does: Breaks open sealed wooden crates, which often hold ammo, weapons or collectibles.
items.use: Comes out on its own at a crate you can open.

items.name: Cut-Off Tool
items.does: Cuts into the yellow SCOOP shipping containers at the docks. You keep it after the mission.
items.use: Used at a SCOOP container's lock.

items.name: Snap Gun
items.does: Opens locked doors without setting off the alarm, so the police take longer to show up.
items.use: Used at a locked door, for example the back door of a jewelry store.
items.n: Yasmani hands it over when you bring him the first piece.

items.name: Key Cloner
items.does: A phone app that opens and starts keyless high-end cars, the ones you can't hotwire. It also opens Randy's wish list.
items.use: Kicks in when you try one of those cars.

items.name: Dye Pack Jammer
items.does: Stops the dye packs hidden in marked bills from going off. You need it for bank and payday loan jobs.
items.use: Works on its own once you have it.

items.name: Headphones
items.does: Music and podcasts while you're on foot, not just in a car. Optional.
items.use: Buy them at an electronics store.

items.name: Masks
items.does: Hide Jason's and Lucia's faces during robberies. Change the one you wear from the item menu.
items.use: Some Ammu-Nation stores sell them; story robberies put one on you.

uses.need: Get through a locked door without the alarm
Keep marked bills from bank or payday loan jobs clean
Search wrecks and the sea floor
Scout a target from a distance

sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 All Equipment
sources.note: Read Nov 22, 2026 (published/modified Nov 19). 12 items under Progress > Equipment; all story unlocks; selected from the Items Wheel next to weapons, some used automatically. Binoculars and Flashlight: Gone Fishing; Duffel Bag: Lab Fees (auto with stolen goods); Headphones: electronics stores (15); Pry Bar and Cut-Off Tool: Meet the Heders; Masks: auto in some story robberies, sold at some Ammu-Nations, switch in Item Menu; Metal Detector: Island Dreams; Slim Jim: Moses (Ch2); Snap Gun: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; Key Cloner: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; Dye Pack Jammer: Credit Check. Trusted.

sources.label: GamesRadar+: All 12 pieces of equipment explained
sources.note: Read Nov 22, 2026 (published Nov 21). Same 12 and same unlock missions. Uses: binoculars scout/mark enemies/identify animals; flashlight, Ammu-Nation torch attachment as alternative; duffel bag holds narcotics, jewellery, marked bills; headphones music/podcasts outside a vehicle, optional; pry bar wooden crates (ammo, weapons, collectibles), automatic; masks conceal identity in robberies; metal detector for Underwater Discoveries, taken from a boat; slim jim silent car entry instead of smashing glass, automatic; snap gun opens locked doors without alarms; cut-off tool yellow Scoop containers, kept; key cloner phone app for keyless cars; dye pack jammer disables dye packs, needed for banks and payday loan stores. Left out: the $20,000 pocket cash / two bags per character detail, the button prompt and the 60 birds (read from a fetch summary, not checked against a second source). Trusted.
